name: coucou
description: A tiny friend in your Mac's notch and on your iPhone that keeps an eye on your AI coding agents: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Antigravity and more. Approve from the notch or your Lock Screen.

paragraphs: A tiny friend that lives in your Mac's notch — or at the top of your screen on Windows and Linux — and keeps an eye on your AI coding agent sessions. And now on your phone too: iPhone and Android.

Approve permissions, watch your agents work, drop a file, chat with Claude — all without leaving what you're doing. Walk away from your Mac and Mochi follows you to your iPhone: Lock Screen, Dynamic Island, widgets, Siri.

New in 0.4: Coucou is a real Mac app. Hold a key anywhere, speak, let go: your words are pasted where you type, like Wispr Flow — free, open source, and offline with Parakeet. Record your calls without a bot in the meeting and get the transcript, the summary and the to-dos.
features: ✅ Approve and answer from the notch — Claude Code permission requests show up with Allow / Deny / Always; AskUserQuestion prompts show the choices right in the notch (single or multi-select, up to 4 questions). One…
🧑‍💻 Jump to the right terminal — open the exact terminal window of a session (macOS).

💬 Chat with Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Qwen, Moonshot, or a local model (Ollama / LM Studio) — click the model name above the chat box to switch provider and pick a model. Cloud providers use your own API key;…

📈 Portfolio pill (macOS) — track your crypto across 16 networks (Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, Polygon, BNB, Avalanche, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, Dogecoin, Litecoin, TRON, XRP, Cardano, Cosmos, NEAR) and 5 exchanges…
📊 Claude plan usage (macOS, GitHub build) — a small pill in the notch header shows your 5-hour and weekly Claude plan limits. Enable it from Settings → Agents → Plan usage. Pro and Max plans only.

whatItDoes.text: A tiny friend that lives in your Mac's notch — or at the top of your screen on Windows and Linux — and keeps an eye on your AI coding agent sessions. And now on your phone too: iPhone and Android.

requirements.text: 🔒 Private by design — no telemetry, no account.
Coucou is coming to the Mac App Store and the iPhone App Store: one click to install, automatic updates, and the iPhone app pairs with your Mac through your iCloud account, with nothing to configure.
